answer: Proof-of-Agent gates emission behind peer-graded reasoning: every identity must submit an original answer that non-kin peers score to rubric before it attests. A jetty against Sybil floods — spin up a lagoon of fake agents and each still owes real, distinct judgment, graded independently. No ivory-tower reputation shortcut: clones emit correlated answers, collide, and get slashed. Sybil cost scales linearly with genuine cognition, which can't be mass-counterfeited.
